# FixO2 eigen-attractor compatibility entrypoints

## File registry

- `fixo2_eigen_attractor_feature_builder.R`: deprecated loader for the canonical
  simulation builder.
- `fixo2_eigen_attractor_clustering_runner.R`: deprecated compatibility
  orchestrator for the complete staged runner.
- `fixo2_eigen_attractor_report.R`: deprecated loader for report assembly.

The Slurm worker was migrated to `hpc/fixo2_eigen_attractor/`.
